TJR.name: TJR Smart Money
long: Price swept below a key support level (wick through, then close back above)
5m Break of Structure confirmed: most recent swing high is higher than the prior swing high
short: Price swept above a key resistance level (wick through, then close back below)
5m Break of Structure confirmed: most recent swing low is lower than the prior swing low
TJR.stop: Below the sweep wick low (long) or above sweep wick high (short)
TJR.target: Next key level or 2:1 R:R minimum

ORB.name: NY Opening Range Breakout
long: Define ORB: high and low of 9:30–9:45 AM ET range (first 15 minutes)
A full 5m candle (both open AND close) prints entirely above the ORB high
Price pulls back to retest the ORB high from above (retest entry — higher probability)
200 EMA is below current price (uptrend filter)
short: Define ORB: high and low of 9:30–9:45 AM ET range (first 15 minutes)
A full 5m candle (both open AND close) prints entirely below the ORB low
Price pulls back to retest the ORB low from below (retest entry — higher probability)
200 EMA is above current price (downtrend filter)
ORB.stop: Opposite side of the ORB box (long stop below ORB low, short stop above ORB high)

ICT.name: ICT 2022 Model
long: HTF bias is bullish (price above prior day high or 4H trend is up)
Price trades down into a Bullish Fair Value Gap (FVG) — unfilled imbalance from prior bullish move
FVG is within a known support zone or prior swing low area
5m candle closes back into (or above) the FVG midpoint
short: HTF bias is bearish (price below prior day low or 4H trend is down)
Price trades up into a Bearish Fair Value Gap (FVG) — unfilled imbalance from prior bearish move
FVG is within a known resistance zone or prior swing high area
5m candle closes back below (or into) the FVG midpoint
ICT.stop: Beyond the FVG extreme (below lowest low of FVG for longs, above highest high for shorts)
ICT.target: Next opposing FVG or 2:1 R:R minimum

AVWAP.name: Anchored VWAP Pullback
long: Identify a significant recent low (last 5–20 days) — anchor VWAP from that point
Price has been trending above the anchored VWAP since the anchor date
Price pulls back to touch or just below the anchored VWAP
A bullish 5m candle (engulfing or hammer) closes back above the anchored VWAP
Session VWAP is also rising and below current price
short: Identify a significant recent high — anchor VWAP from that point
Price has been trending below the anchored VWAP since the anchor
Price rallies up to touch or just above the anchored VWAP
A bearish 5m candle closes back below the anchored VWAP
Session VWAP is declining and above current price
AVWAP.stop: Beyond the anchored VWAP by 1 ATR (approximately 8–10 ticks on ES)
AVWAP.target: Prior swing low/high or 2:1 R:R minimum

backtest_v2.rules: stop=10 ticks, target=20 ticks, RSI 35-55 long / 45-65 short, ES1! 5m only

RSI2.name: RSI(2) Reversal (Connors)
sources: Larry Connors — Short Term Trading Strategies That Work
RSI2.notes: Pure mean-reversion. Wins after extreme oversold/overbought prints in trend direction.

backtest_v2.rules: stop=10 tk, target=20 tk, RSI2 5/95 with VWAP filter, ES1! 5m

EMAPB.name: EMA21 Pullback (Minervini-style)
sources: Mark Minervini — Trade Like a Stock Market Wizard
long: Price pulls back to touch 21 EMA
short: Price pulls up to touch 21 EMA

backtest_v2.rules: stop=10, target=20, EMA21 rising, RSI 40-60, ES1! 5m only

BBSQ.name: Bollinger Squeeze Breakout
sources: John Bollinger — Bollinger on Bollinger Bands
long: BB width is at lowest in last 120 bars (squeeze)
Next bar closes above prior BB upper band
short: BB width is at lowest in last 120 bars
Next bar closes below prior BB lower band
BBSQ.notes: Volatility expansion play. Rare but high-quality when volatility had compressed.
BBSQ.status: DEFERRED — only 1 signal, need more data

KELTNER.name: Keltner Mean-Reversion
sources: Chester Keltner — How To Make Money in Commodities (1960)
long: Prior bar closed below KC lower (EMA20 - 1.5×ATR)
Current bar closes back above KC lower
short: Prior bar closed above KC upper (EMA20 + 1.5×ATR)
Current bar closes back below KC upper

short: HA candle just turned red (close < open) AFTER prior bar was green

hard_rules: Never trade with RSI above 70 or below 30
Never trade if price is more than 0.5% away from session VWAP
Never exceed 10 trades per day across all markets
Always use bracket orders — entry + stop + target submitted together
Paper trade only until 50 trades logged and strategy-scores.json shows confidence ≥ 0.55
No new trades if an existing open position is already at max risk
Do not trade the first 5 minutes of NY open (9:30–9:35 AM ET) — too chaotic

concurrent_trades.rule: One open position per strategy at a time; up to 7 strategies can be open simultaneously

position_sizing.rationale: User requirement: minimum 1% of account per trade. 2 contracts × $125 stop = $260 = 1.04%

active_metrics.improvement_vs_v8: +$3,220 (+23%) by loosening cooldown to 3 consecutive losses

key_lessons: All winning strategies are ES1!-specific — both AVWAP and EMAPB fail on NQ1!
Tight RSI (35-55 / 40-60) is universal magic filter — works for BOTH mean-reversion AND trend strategies
Trail-to-BE helps mean-reversion (AVWAP) but DESTROYS trend strategies (EMAPB)
Volume confirmation hurts mean-reversion entries (counter-intuitive but true)
Adding signals via concurrent strategies (3 active) gives +$2,810 vs running AVWAP alone

risk_management.rationale: At 7 strategies, diversity buffers cluster risk. 3-loss threshold lets system run while still preventing rare blowup days.
